versions.title: Baseline
versions.note: Repeated tables and cone lamps; static road hazards; floor skeleton.

versions.title: Controls and cleanup
versions.note: Corrected visible cart steering; removed skeleton; added positional deep grunts. Maze arrows retain camera turning.

versions.title: Individual maze scenery
versions.note: Four distinct furniture builds, five lamp families with 25 individual fixtures, 29 repaired spiral panels. Mobile: 7.5 s / 2.7 MB / 264 draws. Contact sheet available.

versions.title: Milestone suspense and animation
versions.note: Clue-triggered creaks, brief movement and light fades wait for reading/narration. Moving fabric and five swinging lamps. Event pause/restart browser checks pass.

versions.title: Creature investigation
versions.note: Running and wall mechanisms attract the creature. Sight pursues; lost sight searches the last known position. Physical corridor-crossing, pause and retry tests pass.

versions.title: Creature motion and breathing
versions.note: Asymmetric arm rhythms, recoil and grasping claws, smoke reveal and near breathing. Grunts now change muffling continuously as walls intervene.

versions.title: Six road hazard families
versions.note: Detailed wrecks, stalls, beams, moving signs, rolling barrels and machinery. Shared animation/collision state; advance reflectors and reserved safe tracks.

versions.title: Four carnival districts
versions.note: Ticket proscenium and kiosk, varied midway stalls, broken carousel and wheel yard, corrugated loading shed and gantry. Moving shutters, signs, gondolas, marquee sections and searchlight.
